mapper.sql: SELECT id, user_id, product_line, channel_type, channel_account, is_primary, channel_user_info, bind_time, status, del_flag FROM iam_user_channel
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_channel ( user_id, product_line, channel_type, channel_account, is_primary, channel_user_info, status, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productLine}, #{channelType}, #{channelAccount}, #{isPrimary}, #{channelUserInfo}, '0', '0' )
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_user_channel SET status = '1' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE iam_user_channel SET is_primary = '0' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE iam_user_channel SET del_flag = '1' WHERE user_id = #{userId}
